QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Verdant Flora Savior
QuestInfo.0: It's likely the boy you heard about in the Path to Downtown is a descendant of the Verdant Flora. You should go meet him and see what he knows.
QuestInfo.1: It's a bit of a shock to see that the boy has the same pointy Flora ears that you do.
QuestInfo.2: Now that you've spoken with the Verdant Flora boy, you've met all heroes you can. Nothing to do now but wait to reach the castle, like Edea said.

default.0: Don't you want to share your sotry with someone?
